title: Genie 3: A new frontier for world models
author: Google DeepMind / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Genie 3 can generate dynamic worlds that you can navigate in real time at 24 frames per second, retaining consistency for a few minutes at a resolution of 720p....
body:
Genie 3 can generate dynamic worlds that you can navigate in real time at 24 frames per second, retaining consistency for a few minutes at a resolution of 720p.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [Google DeepMind News](https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-3-a-new-frontier-for-world-models/).
